title: Follow the operator tip-start and bag-label handling steps during a tip cycle
summary: During a tip cycle, the operator starts the tip using the operator station button. Software monitors the tip process and sends a chat prompt to UPS to print a bag label if the cycle started. After the tip, the operator applies the bag label to the bag, places the labeled bag on the takeaway, and hangs the next empty bag for the next tip.
when_to_use: Use this when an AGV tote is staged at the tipper and you are performing the operator portion of the tip cycle: start the tip, handle the UPS bag-label prompt, label the resulting bag, place it on the takeaway, and prepare the next empty bag.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Start the tip using the operator station button; apply the bag label to the bag; place the labeled bag on the takeaway; hang the next empty bag.
safety_notes: Do not continue the cycle blindly if the bag label prompt does not occur or the label cannot be applied; stop and escalate as described in the failure notes.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator access to the tip-start button
Ability to observe/receive the chat prompt for UPS bag label printing (as described by the source)
Bag label handling materials (bag label and bag)

access_required: Operator access to the tip-start button
system_preconditions: A full tote is staged for the tip cycle at the tipper (AGV arrives and tipper is ready for the tip cycle).

visual_references.description: Frame showing the tip cycle operator involvement: operator pushes a button to start the tip; software monitors tip progress and sends a chat message to prompt UPS to print a bag label; after the tip the operator applies the bag label, places the bag on a takeaway, and hangs the next empty bag.

steps.title: Start the tip using the operator station button when the tipper is ready
steps.purpose: Initiate the tip cycle so the system can monitor tip progress and trigger the UPS bag-label prompt.
steps.instruction: When the AGV arrives and the tipper is ready for the tip cycle, push the operator button to start the tip.
steps.expected_result: The tip cycle is started by the operator (tipper begins the tip process).
steps.healthy_condition: After you start the tip, the system proceeds with monitoring the tip process and is able to prompt UPS for bag label printing via chat (as described by the source).
steps.failure_condition: The tip does not start as expected, or the subsequent UPS bag-label prompt does not occur.

actions.label: Push operator button to start tip
actions.exact_action: An operator pushes a button to start the tip.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the bag label prompt does not occur or the label cannot be applied, stop and escalate rather than continuing the cycle blindly.

steps.title: Watch for the software-driven chat prompt to UPS for bag label printing
steps.purpose: Ensure the bag label printing prompt is issued for the started tip cycle so you can label the resulting bag.
steps.instruction: During the tip, watch for the software-driven prompt: the source states software monitors the tip process and sends a chat message to prompt UPS to print a bag label if the cycle started.
steps.expected_result: A chat message prompt is sent to prompt UPS to print a bag label for the started cycle.
steps.healthy_condition: The UPS bag label prompt occurs during/after the tip start, enabling you to apply the correct bag label to the resulting bag.
steps.failure_condition: The bag label prompt does not occur.

actions.label: Monitor for UPS bag label chat prompt
actions.exact_action: Software monitors the tip process and we send a chat message to prompt UPS to print a bag label if it started its cycle.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the bag label prompt does not occur, stop and escalate rather than continuing the cycle blindly.

steps.title: Apply the bag label to the bag after the tip
steps.purpose: Label the resulting bag so it can be correctly handled downstream.
steps.instruction: After the tip completes, apply the bag label to the bag.
steps.expected_result: The bag has the bag label applied.
steps.healthy_condition: The bag label is physically applied to the bag produced by the tip cycle.
steps.failure_condition: The label cannot be applied to the bag.

actions.label: Apply bag label
actions.exact_action: The operator applies the bag labeled to the bag.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the bag label prompt does not occur or the label cannot be applied, stop and escalate rather than continuing the cycle blindly.

steps.title: Place the labeled bag on the takeaway
steps.purpose: Move the labeled bag to the takeaway conveyor/belt for downstream handling.
steps.instruction: Place the labeled bag on the takeaway.
steps.expected_result: The labeled bag is placed on the takeaway.
steps.healthy_condition: The labeled bag is positioned on the takeaway from where it will be conveyed onward.
steps.failure_condition: The labeled bag is not placed on the takeaway.

actions.label: Place bag on takeaway
actions.exact_action: places the bag on a take away from there.

steps.title: Hang the next empty bag for the next tip
steps.purpose: Prepare the system for the next tip cycle by ensuring an empty bag is ready.
steps.instruction: Hang the next empty bag for the next tip.
steps.expected_result: The next empty bag is hung and ready for the next tip cycle.
steps.healthy_condition: An empty bag is prepared/hung for the next tip.
steps.failure_condition: No next empty bag is prepared, delaying the next tip cycle.

actions.label: Hang next empty bag
actions.exact_action: hangs the next empty bag for the next tip.

success_criteria: Tip cycle is started by the operator.
UPS bag label prompt occurs via the software-driven chat message (as described).
Bag label is applied to the resulting bag.
Labeled bag is placed on the takeaway.
Next empty bag is hung for the next tip.
healthy_conditions: After starting the tip, the system sends the chat prompt to UPS to print a bag label.
The bag label is physically applied to the bag produced by the tip cycle.
The labeled bag is on the takeaway and an empty bag is hung for the next tip.
failure_conditions: Bag label prompt does not occur.
Bag label cannot be applied to the bag.
Labeled bag is not placed on the takeaway.
Next empty bag is not prepared/hung.
escalation_guidance: If the bag label prompt does not occur or the label cannot be applied, stop and escalate rather than continuing the cycle blindly.
